claims.text: Nvidia will guarantee up to $105 billion in lease-residual-value obligations for OpenAI's new data-center campus in Pike County, Ohio -- an exact figure stated in Nvidia's SEC filing and confirmed by Nvidia's press release, both disclosed 17 August 2026
claims.reasoning: Falsifier located the SEC filing directly (sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000069/sbeoainvidia-portsrelease.htm) and confirmed the filing states the guarantee is 'cumulatively capped at $105 billion' -- not a headline rounding. Independently corroborated same-day, own-byline, by Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, TechCrunch, Nikkei Asia (falsifier additionally found Axios, UPI and Dayton Daily News independently).

claims.text: Nvidia will separately invest $1.5 billion directly in SB Energy, additive to (not part of) the $105 billion guarantee
claims.reasoning: Verbatim in Nvidia's release; falsifier confirmed consistently described as separate/additive across Nvidia, SB Energy's own site, CNBC and Axios -- no source conflates it with the $105B figure.

claims.text: Capacity: 4.25GW initial, option to extend by 3.75GW, up to 8GW total, phased online starting 2028
claims.reasoning: Nvidia's own release states 4.25 IT-GW initial and 8 IT-GW total planned, phased from 2028. Falsifier flagged one outlet (TradingView) paraphrasing the extension as 'about 3.8GW' -- reconciled as loose rounding, not a real dispute, since 8 minus 4.25 equals Nvidia's own 3.75GW figure exactly.

claims.text: Jobs and community figures: ~35,000 construction jobs through 2032, ~2,500 permanent jobs, $4.2B+ AEP Ohio grid investment, $80M community-benefits fund split evenly SB Energy/OpenAI (NOT Nvidia)
claims.reasoning: CORRECTED POST-FALSIFIER: the verifier's first pass ambiguously implied Nvidia funded $80M of a $120M total. Falsifier checked Nvidia's release and SB Energy's own site directly and found the actual structure is SB Energy's pre-existing $40M plus OpenAI's incremental $40M = $80M total; Nvidia is not named as a funder of this specific fund (its money is in the guarantee and the SB Energy equity stake). Jobs and AEP Ohio grid figures independently confirmed via Dayton Daily News, a local outlet with no PR incentive to inflate.

claims.text: The $105B guarantee is a distinct financing mechanism from Nvidia's 10 August 2026 $500B six-asset-manager platform (Apollo/BlackRock/Blackstone/Brookfield/Goldman Sachs/KKR), already published on this site as nvidia-500b-ai-financing-platform
claims.reasoning: Falsifier searched explicitly for any source conflating the two and found none; one analysis piece (MLQ News) explicitly frames the $500B platform as 'a framework, not a loan book,' reinforcing the mechanism is structurally different from today's direct balance-sheet guarantee.

claims.text: Prior WSJ-attributed reports (unconfirmed at the time) put the guarantee at ~$250B (late July) then under $120B (14 August) -- superseded, not restated, by today's confirmed $105B
claims.reasoning: Labeled single-source deliberately: this is exactly why the story sat in `watching` for three weeks. Falsifier located the stale-rumor artifacts (GovConWire, Tom's Hardware, BigGo Finance) matching the claimed progression and confirmed dates are genuine (SEC filing and all major outlet URLs carry 2026-08-17 dates; no recirculated/misdated story).
